content.text: The insurance clause is present and fully meets the preferred position.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes the insurance obligation on Vendor (Silverline) and matches our preferred position on every material term: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M, and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained throughout the term and for one year afterward. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage, cancellation notice, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all favourable to us. No redline needed.
